scope: One real spawned POKIE CLI process; bounded deterministic Outcome Library build from the checked-in 5x3 sample-slot Blueprint. This is not an exact-enumeration or 17-million-combination measurement.

resources.rssMeasurement: /proc/<pid>/status VmRSS sampled every 10 ms for the spawned CLI child
resources.heapMeasurement: process.memoryUsage() sampled every 10 ms inside the spawned Node CLI process; sampled, not a GC-safe absolute heap peak
